q1_issues.issue: The bare kind symbol salt_bloom fills the Experiencer slot of a single asserted event, so a generic claim about the kind is recorded as one occurrence instead of the verbal-generic rule form prescribed by *Quantifiers, generics & scope* for a generic over a kind.

q2_gaps: a bare mass / non-count kind noun as the SUBJECT of a generic verbal clause: the distributing-rule route is stated for bare plurals and explicit quantifiers, the kind-relation route requires bare kinds on BOTH sides (barred here by the indefinite object), and the bare-class-symbol licence is written for non-specific OBJECTS only - nothing says which form a bare mass subject takes
notes: Reifying an event rather than a kind relation matches the prompt's own "a winch needs an annual inspection" ruling, so only the bare-kind subject slot is at issue; compounds, genus atoms, Experiencer/Stimulus for stative "need", and the 0.9 generic dial are all right. The object witness also asserts that a particular spring-tide fill exists, which "needs" does not claim - an intensional-object consequence of the encoding the instruction set prescribes.
